note:
散步 5 公里，顺路逛了两家皮包店。

第一家是代理商，店里有 Aunts & Uncles、Jost 和 The Bridge。之前在网上种草很久，摸到实物反而没那么想买了。

第二家是 Gusti Leder 的手工皮具店。现场看做工，往好了说有一种质朴的美，往坏了说就是粗粝。花一百欧左右买这样的包，我其实不太能接受。

结论：还是攒钱买 Loewe 吧。或者自己学做皮具，B 站上有不少教学视频，不过工具和皮料估计得回国才买得到。
note_en:
A 5 km walk, with stops at two leather goods shops along the way.

The first was a retailer carrying Aunts & Uncles, Jost and The Bridge. I'd been eyeing these brands online for a while, but once I actually held the bags, I wanted them less.

The second was Gusti Leder, a handmade leather shop. Seeing the craftsmanship up close: generously, it has a rustic, honest charm; less generously, it's just rough. Paying around €100 for a bag like that doesn't sit right with me.

Verdict: I'll keep saving for a Loewe. Or I could learn to make one myself. There are plenty of tutorials on Bilibili, though I'll probably have to wait until I'm back in China to get the tools and leather.

note:
从 Luxor 电影院骑车回宿舍，两趟各 20 分钟。

这次是去看《指环王》加长版。第二部和第三部完整看了，第一部只赶上了波洛米尔死后的结尾，因为我完全忘了自己订过票，先跑去了 Park Café。

加长版对膀胱真是个挑战。我时不时起身去厕所，左边那对小情侣估计已经很无语了。说是加长，其实我也说不清加在哪里，可能是法拉米尔和伊欧文的几段（确实不如不加），还有灰港告别那部分。

看完去搜了巴拉希尔之戒，发现 The Noble Collection 的正版和 Weta 出的好像不太一样。我甚至翻出卷尺量了手指围度，但想了想还是算了，不如淘宝买个不锈钢的。

最后一点感想：阿拉贡的演员还是脏发中分更帅，洗了头反而显得发际线堪忧。
note_en:
Cycled back to the dorm from the Luxor cinema, two rides of 20 minutes each.

I went to see the extended editions of The Lord of the Rings. I watched The Two Towers and The Return of the King in full, but only caught the very end of The Fellowship of the Ring, after Boromir's death, because I'd completely forgotten I had booked tickets and went to Park Café first.

The extended cut is a real test for the bladder. I kept getting up for the restroom, and I suspect the couple on my left had run out of patience with me. Honestly, I couldn't tell exactly what had been added. Maybe a few Faramir and Éowyn scenes (the film would have been better without them), and part of the farewell at the Grey Havens.

Afterwards I looked up the Ring of Barahir. The official one from The Noble Collection seems to differ from the Weta version. I even dug out a tape measure to check my ring size, then thought better of it. A stainless steel one from Taobao will do.

One last thought: the actor who plays Aragorn looks better with greasy, center-parted hair. Once it's washed, his hairline starts to look worrying.
